english.title: Wilfully disturb any spawn / spawning fish
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not having a legal right to take materials from any waters, wilfully disturbed

(A)_[spawn]_
(B)_[spawning fish]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(4) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

english.notes:
(i) A person charged with this offence is not entitled to raise a defence that he was a riparian owner with the right to cross the river either on foot or by any other means (National Rivers Authority v Jones (1992) Times, 10 March).
(ii) See Section 2(5) for defence of prior written authority.
(iii) See offence wording H2910 for offence of wilfully disturbing any bed bank or shallow on which any spawn or spawning fish may be.
(iv) This offence wording ONLY applies to salmon, trout and freshwater fish.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
